question: After fs-safe 0.5 is published, should backup publication retain the current `link-required` behavior, or should this migration also adopt the proposed verified `link-or-copy` fallback for filesystems without hard links?
rationale: Both choices are deliberate filesystem-safety policies with different availability and no-clobber guarantees; the code cannot infer which operational trade-off OpenClaw should make.

options.title: Retain link-required for this migration
options.body: Publish fs-safe 0.5, regenerate the lock artifacts, and land the race-safety migration without changing the existing backup fallback contract.

options.title: Adopt verified link-or-copy
options.body: Extend this PR with targeted backup restore and collision proof plus user-facing documentation for the new fallback behavior before merge.

recommendation.title: Retain link-required for this migration
recommendation.body: Publish fs-safe 0.5, regenerate the lock artifacts, and land the race-safety migration without changing the existing backup fallback contract.
